description.value:
A compact, hovering frame packed with sensors.

Size Small

Speeds land 25 feet, fly 20 feet

Attacks Ranged 1 spark (range increment 30 feet), Damage 1d4 electricity

Attribute Modifiers Str +0, Dex +3, Con +1, Int -4, Wis +3, Cha +0

Ancestry Hit Points 4

Trained Skill Stealth

Senses Darkvision (plus the construct base senses: precise vision, imprecise hearing, vague touch)

Support Benefit: Early Warning Array Your robot companion is alert and ready to warn you of danger. Until the end of your next turn, creatures adjacent to the surveillance chassis can't flank you or cause you to become off-guard.

Advanced Maneuver: Blinding Spotlight 2 (Light) Your robot companion shines a powerful spotlight on a creature it can see within 60 feet. The target becomes dazzled until the end of your next turn or until it uses the Avert Gaze action, whichever comes first. This Points Out the creature if it was undetected by you or one or more of your allies. (Requires Advanced Drone feat)
